reader.requirement: At --std 85, a sequential READ that finds no next logical record (end of file, or the first READ of an absent OPTIONAL input file) is unsuccessful with I-O status '10' (the at end condition, class 1), the AT END imperative runs instead of any USE procedure, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure runs when AT END is absent, and the following READ is '46' rather than another at end.

edition-consulted.switches: Year < 2002: a READ with no AT END and no applicable USE procedure is refused (COBOL6826, §1985:VII.4.4.3 SR2); at 2002+ no such requirement
passes --std into the connector (FileConnector.Edition); on the sequential READ path the only reader of it is SharingFacilityInEffect, which the read guard and the '10'/'46' arms do not consult

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|IsActive|DialectLevel in SequentialConnector*.cs, FileConnector.cs, SequentialIoBinder.cs, SequentialIoEmitter.cs, DispatchEmitter.cs, EcEmitter.cs, IoStatusClass.cs; DialectBehavior enum has no at-end member. The runtime at-end arms (ReadRecord EOF -> AtEnd, SequentialReadGuard OptionalAbsent -> AtEnd, LastReadUnsuccessful -> 46) carry no edition test.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only at compile time: at 85 READ without AT END needs an applicable USE procedure (SR2) and READ PREVIOUS is refused; the runtime at end condition ('10', AT END vs USE, then '46') is the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise '10' / '46' sequencing and the absent-OPTIONAL first read, and PREVIOUS at 85; not exercised: the USE procedure taking '10' when AT END is absent, a RECORD VARYING / OCCURS DEPENDING file read to its end, a READ after a failed OPEN

probes.printed: GOT REC1 00 / GOT REC2 00 / ATEND3 FS=10 / AFTER3 10 / USE RAN FS=46 (AT END not taken) / AFTER4 46 / no-AT-END read at EOF: USE RAN FS=10, AFTER-NO-ATEND FS=10 / OPTIONAL absent: OPT OPEN 05, OPT ATEND FO=10, second READ not at end / missing non-optional: OPEN 35 (USE ran), READ 47 (USE ran, AT END not taken)
probes.expected: EOF read: '10' and AT END runs, USE not run (VII.4.4.4 GR10 b); without AT END the USE procedure runs (GR10 c); next READ '46' (VII.1.3.5 status list 4 e 2); absent OPTIONAL first READ '10' (status list 2 a 2); READ after failed OPEN is '47', not at end

probes.printed: W FS=00 / W FS=00 / GOT 3-ABC RL=05 FS=00 / GOT 1-Z RL=03 FS=00 / ATEND FS=10 RL=03
probes.expected: two variable-length records (RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON, OCCURS DEPENDING ON in the record) then the at end condition '10'

probes.printed: error COBOL6826 READ of sequential file 'SQ' specifies no AT END phrase, and no applicable USE ... (§1985:VII.4.4.3 SR2); error COBOL0900 READ PREVIOUS requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: 85 requires AT END when no USE applies; PREVIOUS is not in the 1985 READ format

reader.notes: The at end condition is produced by the runtime connector's EOF and absent-OPTIONAL arms with no edition test; the 85-only differences are compile-time (mandatory AT END-or-USE, PREVIOUS refused) and both behave as the 1985 text says. Every probe printed what VII.1.3.5 and VII.4.4.4 GR10/GR12 require.
